name: Primer
about: In the style of GitHub's Primer design system.

settings.font-sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji"
settings.font-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace
settings.shadow-md: 0 6px 12px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / calc(0.1 * var(--t-shadow-strength))), 0 6px 18px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / calc(0.3 * var(--t-shadow-strength)))
settings.shadow-lg: 0 8px 24px rgb(0 0 0 / calc(0.3 * var(--t-shadow-strength))), 0 40px 80px rgb(0 0 0 / calc(0.6 * var(--t-shadow-strength)))
